Two spin-1 sites give 3 ⊗ 3 = 9 states, which decompose under SU(2) as
S=2 ⊕ S=1 ⊕ S=0 with dimensions 5 + 3 + 1 = 9.
The projector P2 = (SS² + 3·SS + 2·I) / 6 evaluates to 1 on the S=2
subspace and 0 on S=1 and S=0.
Multiplicities follow the eigenvalues: rank(P2) = dim(S=2) = 5.
This is the mathematical basis for the G3 rank-5 assertion.

raw.description:
Defines the quadrant classification of the quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0
based on the discriminant Δ = b² − 4ac and its relation to the golden ratio φ.
Hepta-prime index: 510510 = 2·3·5·7·11·13·17 = Ωⁿ.
Valid genesis entry: SHA3-256 domain-separated hash + Ed25519 check of ledger 8980.

quadrant_definition.phase_angle: φ * π / 2  (≈ 202.6°)  – aligns with Layer 314 anchor

root_conditions.Δ < 0: Two complex conjugate roots → Quadrants II & III (φ-negative)
root_conditions.Δ = 0: One double root → Tangent to origin (φ-neutral)
root_conditions.Δ > 0: Two distinct real roots → Quadrants I & IV (φ-positive)

φ_harmonic_map.Quadrant I: Δ > 0, roots have same sign as a
φ_harmonic_map.Quadrant II: Δ < 0, complex with positive real part
φ_harmonic_map.Quadrant III: Δ < 0, complex with negative real part
φ_harmonic_map.Quadrant IV: Δ > 0, roots have opposite sign to a

consistency.relation: Sidecar inherits quadratic-quadrant genesis 510510; does not overwrite it.
